description:
Driven by their passionate love of swordsmanship, a group of social elites pool their money to bring the year’s biggest and most prestigious competition aboard the enormous cruise ship Platinum Tower. “At the top of the tower, every wish comes true”… Competitors yearning to change their fate and driven by their desires flock to the ship, battling their way up in a deadly race for the championship. As blades clash time and again, who will earn the favor of the goddesses of fate?

(Source. Bilibili TV)
